landing.title: Modernize your Discord community
landing.description: Lacuna is a powerful tool for improving community functionality with an intuitive interface
landing.bf_stability_description: High stability, speed, performance, and minimization of downtime due to powerful servers.
landing.bf_ease_description: Clear interface, in which it is impossible to get lost in, and which allows you to quickly and easily configure the necessary modules.
landing.bf_functionality_description: Flexible and various features to improve and complement the Discord community.
landing.ft_activities_description: Earn experience and currencies by being active on the server and get awards, as well as complete with other users for an honor place in the leaderboard.
landing.ft_moderation_description: Simple command and clear descriptions, as well as auto-moderating will allow your community to protect itself from troublemakers. You'll also have an action log to keep track of events and moderators their penalties, and a reporting system will allow your members to send reports to you or your moderators for review.
landing.ft_subscriptions_description: Add Twitch and YouTube channel to receive alerts about video release or about the live broadcast.
landing.ft_music_description: Listen to your favorite music in voice channels. Lacuna supports YouTube, Twitch, SoundCloud, direct links to audio recordings and radio. Fill your community with music.
landing.ft_utility_description: Interactive messages and reactions, creating temporary voice channels, automatically adding roles, custom commands and more!

patrons.gratitude_message_p1: We want to express our sincere gratitude for your financial support of our bot! Your generous donation helps us further develop and improve our bot so that it can continue to provide useful services and be a useful tool for users.
patrons.gratitude_message_p2: Your kind donation makes a real difference in our work, and we appreciate your trust and support. Together we can make Lacuna even better by offering new features, improving the interface and making it more efficient.
patrons.gratitude_message_p3: We are deeply grateful for the loyal cooperation and trust you show in our project. Your support inspires us and gives us the energy to keep working. We are committed to continuing to develop and improve Lacuna so that it continues to be a valuable tool for you and other users.
